method: Direct observation and interaction in the running game, followed by a complete process exit, relaunch, Continue, and CNS configuration readback.
scope: Existing camp save, CNS close-up and rear cameras, normal gameplay idle; no broad combat or extreme-pose sweep.
observations: Hood has a smooth glossy black crown and covers the ears, sides and rear. The face opening follows the existing mask seal.
Valve Off removes the raised external assembly; the existing visor valve port remains visible. Cup and its molded collar are separately controlled.
Hair and hairpin were temporarily hidden through CNS for coverage inspection. No hair assets or automatic hair-hiding behavior are included in the mod.
The original CNS save was backed up before testing and restored byte-for-byte after the game closed. The game remains closed.
Game progress saves were not rolled back; normal game save writes during the test were retained.
limitations: Limited camp/idle visual and controls test; no exhaustive combat, facial-animation, extreme-neck-motion or alternate-head validation.
The hood shares the rigid glasses Root attachment. Its short neck cuff does not deform with neck motion.
Hair intersections are outside scope; hair remains unchanged by the mod.
All eight toggle combinations passed static section checks; the live test sampled independent toggles and combined-off states, not an exhaustive eight-state screenshot matrix.
